description.value:
Frequency once per day

Until the end of your next turn, your Feral Bond acts on its own: it takes a full three actions on its turn without you spending any action to Command it, and it may act on its own judgment rather than following your direction.

cinderfall.incomplete: Directly matches the shape of P7's Companion's Cry (spend more of your own economy so your companion gets more) and Mature Animal Companion (companion acts without being Commanded) — both real, both ship rules: []. This effect buffs, protects, or grants actions to the Feral Bond (the companion beast) from the holder's own card. No rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet -- confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem (Ranger/Druid), where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too.
